body:
9.2 "Verify that sensitive data is classified and a policy is created for how this data must be protected." -> "Identify all sensitive data created and processed by the application and ensure that a policy is in place on how to deal with sensitive data"

9.6 "Verify that users have a method to remove or export their data on demand." If this is for GPDR compliance, I think this should only be required if GDPR is required.  Otherwise, placing this as a requirement on L1 applications is a little excessive IMHO.  It would be nice to have all applications comply but I think that it can be added once privacy standards are more ubiquitous. So I would mention if this is required (similar to how 9.10 mentions it)

comments.body: I adjusted 9.2 - but I think 9.6 is good as is. Folks can certainly fork the standard and remove it but I think it's important as is. Addressed in 346987e6f378023256afef12e6da0d2b463baa24
